name: Marina Kaplan
source:
Marina's carefree personality makes her quite popular among her classmates. Adults don't seem to like her very much, probably due to poor grades. Despite the girl's outgoing nature, her worldview is rather cynical.

[From the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4122860/ZATO__I_Love_the_World_and_Everything_In_It/]Steam page[/url]]
